name: io.github.sriinnu/tokmeter
title: Tokmeter — AI Agent Usage & Cost
description: Shows what your AI coding agents actually cost — tokens and spend by project, model and day, across Claude Code, Codex and 14 more, read from local session files. No API keys, no telemetry.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio. The package's default command starts the live terminal UI instead, so this argument is required.
